notebooks.title: 增量预测与滚动重算
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.optimize import minimize, LinearConstraint

cells.code:
# 一变量凸QP，约束同时包含输入幅值和变化率
def hold_plan(x,previous,npred=4,bound=1.):
    powers = .8**np.arange(1,npred+1)
    g = 1-powers
    free = powers*x+g*previous
    den = .1+g@g
    zfree = g@(1-free)/den
    low,high = max(-bound,-2-previous),min(bound,2-previous)
    z = np.clip(zfree,low,high)
    prediction = free+g*z
    residual = abs(z-np.clip(z-2*(den*z-g@(1-free)),low,high))
    return z,previous+z,prediction,float(np.sum((prediction-1)**2)+.1*z*z),residual
first = hold_plan(0.,0.)
measured = first[2][0]+.4
second = hold_plan(measured,first[1])
print('default_H_f',2*(.1+np.sum((1-.8**np.arange(1,5))**2)),-2*np.sum(1-.8**np.arange(1,5)))
print('default_first',first)
print('default_measured_replan',measured,second)
assert first[4]<1e-12 and second[4]<1e-12
for shock in [0.,.4,-.4]:
    result = hold_plan(first[2][0]+shock,first[1])
    print('replan_case',shock,'u',result[1],'residual',result[4])

# 保留原.9/.1、Ts=.5、20步实验；改用正确的阶跃增量矩阵
a,b,Ts,Np,Nu,R = .9,.1,.5,10,5,.1
S = np.tril(np.ones((Nu,Nu)))
G = np.array([[b*sum(a**r for r in range(j-l)) if j>l else 0. for l in range(Nu)] for j in range(1,Np+1)])
H = 2*(G.T@G+R*np.eye(Nu))
states,inputs,plans = [0.],[],[]
previous,guess = 0.,np.zeros(Nu)
for k in range(20):
    free = a**np.arange(1,Np+1)*states[-1]+(1-a**np.arange(1,Np+1))*previous
    linear = 2*G.T@(free-1)
    objective = lambda z: .5*z@H@z+linear@z
    jacobian = lambda z: H@z+linear
    result = minimize(objective,guess,jac=jacobian,bounds=[(-2.,2.)]*Nu,constraints=[LinearConstraint(S,-5-previous,5-previous)],method='SLSQP',options={'ftol':1e-12,'maxiter':200})
    assert result.success,result.message
    z = result.x
    violation = max(np.max(np.abs(z))-2,np.max(np.abs(previous+S@z))-5,0.)
    assert violation<1e-8
    # 本次运行绝对输入边界未活跃，因此可用增量盒投影核驻点
    assert np.max(np.abs(previous+S@z))<5-1e-6
    residual = np.max(np.abs(z-np.clip(z-jacobian(z),-2,2)))
    assert residual<1e-5
    plans.append({'x':states[-1],'previous':previous,'du':z.tolist(),'residual':residual})
    previous += z[0]
    inputs.append(previous)
    states.append(a*states[-1]+b*previous)
    guess = np.r_[z[1:],0.]
fig,axes = plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(9,5))
axes[0].plot(np.arange(21)*Ts,states,'o-')
axes[0].axhline(1,color='gray',linestyle='--')
axes[0].set(xlim=(0,10),ylim=(-.5,2.5),ylabel='State')
axes[1].step(np.arange(21)*Ts,inputs+[inputs[-1]],where='post')
axes[1].set(xlim=(0,10),ylim=(-5.5,5.5),xlabel='Time (s)',ylabel='Input')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print('original_contract_corrected',Np,Nu,'variables',Nu,'input_and_rate_inequalities',4*Nu)
print('rollout_last_sample',states[-1],'max_abs_u',max(np.abs(inputs)))
print('rollout_max_residual',max(p['residual'] for p in plans))

# 当前状态费用，P_N=0；必须区分计划尾项与下一次重新规划
def gains(a,N,Pterminal=0.):
    P = Pterminal
    ks = []
    for i in range(N):
        ks.append(a*P/(1+P))
        P = 1+a*a*P/(1+P)
    return ks[::-1],P
for aa in [2.,1.5]:
    for N in [1,2,3]:
        ks,P = gains(aa,N)
        print('finite_horizon',aa,N,'first_gain',ks[0],'pole',aa-ks[0],'planned_last_gain',ks[-1])
Pinf = 2+np.sqrt(5.)
ks,_ = gains(2.,1,Pinf)
print('DARE_P_gain_pole',Pinf,ks[0],2-ks[0])
assert abs(Pinf-(1+4*Pinf/(1+Pinf)))<1e-12

# 终端局部合同；Nu=1尾部保持不总对移位操作封闭
Pterminal = 1.1/(1-.6**2)
grid = np.linspace(-1,1,101)
assert np.max(np.abs(.6*grid))<=1
assert np.allclose(Pterminal*((.6*grid)**2-grid**2),-1.1*grid**2)
print('local_terminal_P',Pterminal)
old = np.array([-1.,-1.])
shifted = np.array([old[1],0.])
fresh = np.array([-.5,-.5])
assert 2+old.sum()==0 and 1+fresh.sum()==0
assert shifted[0]!=shifted[1]
print('held_tail_counterexample','old',old,'shifted',shifted,'fresh',fresh)

notebooks.title: 五题矩阵与参数复算
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm, solve_discrete_are

cells.code:
# 答案1：未来费用和当前费用分别求解，禁止混用
F = np.array([.8,.64,.512])
Phi = np.array([[.2,0.,0.],[.16,.2,0.],[.128,.16,.2]])
H = 2*(Phi.T@Phi+.1*np.eye(3))
linear = 2*Phi.T@F
Uf = np.linalg.solve(H,-linear)
W = np.diag([1.,1.,0.])
Hcurrent = 2*(Phi.T@W@Phi+.1*np.eye(3))
Ucurrent = np.linalg.solve(Hcurrent,-2*Phi.T@W@F)
assert abs(Ucurrent[-1])<1e-12
print('exercise1_H_f',H,linear)
print('exercise1_future_U',Uf)
print('exercise1_current_U',Ucurrent)
shift = np.array([-.3,.2,-.1,0.,0.])
increment_tail = -.8*.3
absolute_tail_as_increment = -.8*.3-.1
print('exercise3_shift_tails',shift,increment_tail,absolute_tail_as_increment)

# 答案4/5：变量口径、准确ZOH与单位归一化
print('exercise4_variables',2*10,3*20+2*10)
v,L,Ts = 20.,2.5,.05
Ac = np.array([[0.,v],[0.,0.]])
Bc = np.array([[0.],[v/L]])
Md = expm(Ts*np.block([[Ac,Bc],[np.zeros((1,3))]]))
Ad,Bd = Md[:2,:2],Md[:2,2:]
assert np.allclose(Ad,[[1.,1.],[0.,1.]])
assert np.allclose(Bd,[[.2],[.4]])
Q = np.diag([1/.5**2,1/.1**2])
R = 1/np.deg2rad(5.)**2
Pf = solve_discrete_are(Ad,Bd,Q,np.array([[R]]))
K = np.linalg.solve(np.array([[R]])+Bd.T@Pf@Bd,Bd.T@Pf@Ad)
print('exercise5_Ad_Bd',Ad,Bd)
print('exercise5_Q_R',Q,R)
print('exercise5_candidate_window_distance',15*Ts,v*15*Ts)
print('exercise5_unconstrained_terminal_P_K',Pf,K)
assert np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(Ad-Bd@K)))<1
print('exercise5_scope','unconstrained local design only; constrained region unverified')
